items.text: The stopwatch on the rail opens the Performance display again (it had slipped to Statistics when that was added). Holding the field pole now opens Dice and air, where the field's controls live, instead of MIDI. Every way into the display now finds its pane by name, so adding a pane cannot shift them again.

The heads-up display pop-up now sits exactly on the bottom edge of the stage and never rises above the stage's top, so its top is no longer cut off on an iPad in landscape. Its tab bar stays fixed at the bottom of the pop-up, and the panes scroll above it.
The lit one of Halo and Draw now looks like the other rail buttons: a yellow icon and a yellow bar on its left edge, with no filled yellow background. The other icon stays grey.
The Sound load button on the right edge now has the same rounded shape as its frame (top right and bottom right). Pressing it used to flash an older shape with only the bottom right rounded.

Halo and Draw are two icons stacked on the rail, Halo on top and Draw (a drop, a triangle and a circle) below, sharing one pill like a toggle group. The one in use is filled; the other is dim. Picking a colour or mark in the strip still switches Draw on.
The pencil is now first on the rail, above the finger and the fist. Tapping it no longer moves it, because the fist that disappears in edit sits below.
Halo and Draw are one two-icon toggle on the rail: both icons show, the one in use is lit and the other dim, so you can always see that Halo is there. Picking a colour or mark switches Draw on.
The mark icons in the small chips were squashed (ovals and stretched triangles). They are round and square again.
Halo and Draw are now one toggle on the rail: its icon shows the mode you are in, and a tap switches to the other. One button fewer on the right.
